Green Building, 30 W. Spring Street, Columbus, Ohio, on Level 2 Room 2. The purpose of the hearing is to solicit public comment on proposed changes to Ohio Administrative Code Section 102-5-05. The rule is being amended to change the procedure by which the Ethics Commission determines whether certain public officials or employees under the Commission’s authority should be required to file annual financial disclosure statements. The amendment also provides a website address where anyone can find a copy of the list of boards and commissions whose members and directors are required to file disclosure statements. All interested parties are entitled to attend the hearing. At the hearing, people affected by the proposed actions may appear and be heard in person, by an attorney, or both; may present their positions, arguments, or contentions orally or in writing; may offer witnesses; and may present evidence tending to show that the proposed rules, if adopted, will be unreasonable or unlawful. Written comments received in the Commission’s offices by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, July 10, 2026 will also be considered. Written comments can be mailed to the Ohio Ethics Commission, ATTN: Rules, 30 W. Spring Street, Columbus, OH 43215, or emailed to: Paul.Nick@ethics.ohio.gov. All oral and written comments presented at the hearing, and all timely received written statements, will be considered by the Ohio Ethics Commission prior to final action on this Rule. BEFORE THE OHIO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY Public Notice Proposed Rulemaking Governing Ohio Administrative Code (OAC) Chapter 3745-80 Five Year Rule Review Statewide Motor Vehicle Anti-Tampering Notice is hereby given that the Director of Environmental Protection, under the authority of Sections 3704.03 and 3704.16 of the Ohio Revised Code and in accordance with Chapter 119, proposes to amend the following rules of the Ohio Administrative Code: 3745-80-01 Definitions 3745-80-02 Tampering Prohibitions 3745-80-03 Anti-tampering Inspection Procedures and Requirements This chapter addresses Statewide Motor Vehicle Anti-Tampering regulations. The purpose of this rule-making is to update the rules to reflect the changes made to the Ohio Revised Code (ORC) 3704.16 that became effective April 9, 2025. These changes involved allowing dealerships to sell tampered vehicles to other dealerships at auto auctions provided the auction firm gives the proper notice of the tampered vehicles during the auction of the vehicles. Additionally, various minor changes were made for clarification, to fix typographical errors, to meet state and agency formatting standards, and to update the availability of items referenced in this chapter as part of a review to fulfill the requirements of ORC 106.03 five-year review. Pursuant to Section 121.39 of the Ohio Revised Code, DAPC was required to consult with interested parties affected by the rules before the Division formally adopts them. On April 6, 2026, these rules went out for a 30-day review by interested parties. Please see the rule synopsis, available electronically at the web address below, for a complete summary of the proposed rule amendments. The public comment period will run until July 30, 2026. A public hearing on this proposed rulemaking will be held to consider public comments in accordance with Section 106.03 of the Ohio Revised Code. Ohio EPA will be holding an in-person and virtual public hearing on the rules at 10:30am on July 30, 2026. The in-person hearing will be at the same time and date and will be located at Ohio EPA, Suite 700, 50 W. Town Street, Columbus, Ohio 43215. ACTION: Original DATE: 07/16/2026 12:05 PM OHIO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY Public Notice Proposed Rulemaking Governing Ohio NPDES Permits Notice is hereby given that the Director of Environmental Protection, under the authority of Sections 6111.03, 6111.042, and 6111.46 of the Ohio Revised Code and in accordance with Chapter 119, proposes to original file the following rules of the Ohio Administrative Code:
Rule #:Title:
3745-33-01Definitions.
3745-33-06Treatment and disposal standards and permit limits.
These rules address Ohio National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Permits. The purpose of this rule making is to conduct the five year rule review of two rules in OAC Chapter 3745-33. In addition, this rulemaking will establish a procedure for applying nutrient control measures in NPDES permits that are responsive to nutrient impairment or at risk findings. The public comment period will run until August 24, 2026. A public hearing on this proposed rulemaking will be held to consider public comments in accordance with Section 119.03 of the Ohio Revised Code. Ohio EPA will be holding an in-person and virtual public hearing on the rules on Monday, August 24, 2026, at 10:30a.m. The in-person hearing will be at the same time and date and will be located at Ohio EPA, Suite 700, 50 W.
